core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Cyberpunk aesthetics with Organic Sustainability.
Emotion First: Evoke 'Responsible Innovation' - serious but hopeful.
Content is King: Data is the hero. Use 'Bento' grids to make complex metrics digestible.
Negative Space: Use deep purple voids to make neon green data pop.
anti_patterns: No flat, lifeless dashboards. Use subtle glows and glassmorphism.
No 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Manrope' for character.

Button.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,255,148,0.3)] font-semibold rounded-full px-6
Button.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/90 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(112,0,255,0.3)] rounded-full px-6
Button.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 rounded-full px-6

Input.base: bg-white/5 border-white/10 focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 rounded-lg h-12

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts link to public/index.html immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the colors defined in 'theme.colors'. Extend the theme, do not overwrite completely.
3. GLOBAL CSS: Update index.css with the CSS variables for the colors. Ensure .dark class is handled correctly.
4. SHADCN OVERRIDES: When using Shadcn components, apply the 'Card' and 'Button' styles defined in 'components' section using cn() utility.
5. LAYOUTS: Use the 'Bento Grid' strategy for the Dashboard. Do not use simple flex-col.
6. CHARTS: Use Recharts. Style them to match the neon theme (dark bg, neon lines).
7. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards).
8. DO NOT ASK QUESTIONS. Just build it.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
